row: Nora B is a pediatric physical therapist based out of Santa Monica. She primarily comes to the home or another location in the community to provide support to parents and other caregivers to help their babies, toddlers, and children of all ages develop into their most independent and active selves. She provides facilitation techniques, coaching, hands-on support, and all kinds of ideas to make your kiddo engage in therapeutic activities while playing.
